user.title: Echo Kiosk Offline Updates
user.description: Mirrors LineageOS Echo image releases (and optionally Kiosk Satellite APKs) into Home Assistant's web server so devices on a network without internet access can update from Home Assistant instead of GitHub.

data.release_repo: GitHub repository with the device images
data.base_url: Base URL the devices use to reach Home Assistant
data.www_subdir: Folder name under the Home Assistant www directory
data.kiosk_universal_only: Kiosk Satellite: mirror only the universal APK
